turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Um, well, my family actually asked me to come in. It's mostly about... well, it's about my father's death. 

I know everyone keeps telling me that the hospital records and the donation emails all line up perfectly. But I look at data for a living, and when I actually compare the timestamps, the missing attachments... and just the way certain community members completely avoid my questions when I bring it up... it’s obvious to me that someone is hiding what really happened. I'm just trying to get to the bottom of it, but it's causing some friction with my family, so... here I am.
